sloka: न ते पापम् इदम् कर्म सुख उदर्कम् भविष्यति ।या अहम् नीता विना भावम् पति पार्श्वात् त्वया वनात् ॥३-५६-१३॥
transliteration: na te pāpam idam karma sukha udarkam bhaviṣyati ।yā aham nītā vinā bhāvam pati pārśvāt tvayā vanāt ॥3-56-13॥

translations.english: This evil deed(of abduction) will not yield happy results.You have brought me from my husband from the forest without any forethought.
